title: 7 Midsize Trucks Fighting for Buyers in 2027 (Who Is Really Winning)
description:
A small Nissan pickup grew forty percent in one year, while one of the most famous Jeeps lost a fifth of its sales. And the average full-size truck now costs sixty-seven thousand, four hundred forty-six dollars. Something strange is happening to the American pickup, and it is happening in the middle of the lineup. Here is the real story of the midsize truck comeback.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
2:47 1. Toyota Tacoma
3:57 2. Nissan Frontier
5:00 3. Ford Maverick
6:12 4. Chevrolet Colorado and GMC Canyon
7:13 5. Ford Ranger
8:18 6. Jeep Gladiator
9:22 7. Honda Ridgeline
10:12 The big picture
20:24 What to check before you buy in 2027

Sources:
We checked the numbers, and the answer has a twist. Yes, midsize trucks are growing faster than full-size trucks. But not every midsize truck is winning, and some of them are collapsing. One of them nearly doubled the sales of Toyota's full-size Tundra. One lost a third of its sales in a quarter. And one has rumors around it that nobody has confirmed. Stay with me, because every number comes from a published source, listed in the description.
